name: Maclure Vineyards
summary: Maclure Vineyards is a sprawling agricultural estate in southern Elwynn Forest owned by the Maclure family. While known for producing grapes and wine for the kingdom of Stormwind, the farmstead is equally infamous for an ongoing, bitter feud with the neighboring Stonefield family.

sections.title: A Bitter Harvest
sections.body: Nestled in the lush hills of southern Elwynn Forest, the Maclure Vineyards should be a peaceful haven of winecraft and farming. Instead, everyday labor is overshadowed by a vicious, long-standing rivalry with the Stonefields just down the road. Accusations of theft and bad blood run deep between the households, keeping tempers flaring even as common troubles—like hungry prowling boars and encroaching kobolds—threaten both homesteads.

sections.title: A Forbidden Romance
sections.body: Despite the fierce animosity between the two patriarchs, young love has crossed the boundary lines. Maybell Maclure and Tommy Joe Stonefield have fallen secretly in love, meeting in hidden groves away from their parents' suspicious eyes. Those passing through the vineyards often find themselves drawn into running secret messages, resolving petty grievances, and trying to help the young couple escape the shadow of their families' grudge.

faq.q: Why are the Maclures and Stonefields fighting?
aliases: why do they hate each other
faq.answer: The rivalry is a long-standing rural feud built on years of mistrust, petty accusations, and stubborn pride. Neither family trusts the other an inch, blaming each other for lost goods and livestock, though neither has outright proof of foul play.

Maybell is the daughter of the Maclure household. She has secretly fallen in love with Tommy Joe Stonefield, defying her family's bitter hatred of their neighbors in the hope of finding a way for them to be together.

faq.q: What threats do the vineyards face?
faq.answer: Aside from family disputes, the vineyards are plagued by ravenous wild boars trampling the crops and vines, as well as wandering kobolds raiding nearby fields from surrounding gold mines.

faq.q: What do the Maclures produce here?
faq.answer: The Maclure family cultivates grapevines to supply wine and fresh fruit to tavern-keepers and merchants throughout Elwynn Forest and Stormwind City.

angles.text: For humans of Stormwind, the vineyard feud is a classic example of countryside stubbornness, reminding travelers that even within the heartland, neighbors often bicker over fences while larger perils loom.
The estate serves as an important breadbasket and vineyard supplying the nearby settlements of Goldshire and Stormwind City with food and spirits.
